# Patterns for reusable-content-scan.yml.
# One ripgrep regex per line. `#` starts a comment. Blank lines ignored.
# When a review sweep finds new leaked content, add the pattern here so
# the next PR fails until it is removed.
#
# NOTE this file lives in THIS repo, not gh-workflows — the shared
# reusable ships no wordlist.

# --- private LAN topology (RFC1918) ---
\b10\.10\.0\.
\b192\.168\.

# --- private hostnames / box aliases ---
\barthur\b
\bagx-node\b
\bbifrost\b
\bheimdall\b

# --- internal project codenames not for public docs ---
\bnusomi\b
\bspectry\b
\bcorrograph\b
\bfleet-harness\b
\bgrounder-bench\b
# "Hermes" is generic enough to hit false positives (Greek god, etc.);
# scope to the internal-agent sense with the surrounding capitalization.
\bHermes\s+(agent|slot|plugin|gateway)\b

# --- internal-jargon phrases ---
\baux fleet\b
\baux stack\b
\bswap[- ]router\b

# --- journal-voice phrases ---
\bfor tonight\b
\bnext[- ]session\b
\bstopping point\b
\bqueued next-session\b

# --- absolute homedir paths that leak the box layout ---
/home/agx_orin
/generative-AI-models

# --- real-name / real-email patterns ---
noah@x\.com
